description: This file defines the CreateSnapshotAction class and its methods for creating a snapshot of a device or environment, including handling suspend, snapshot, and resume operations.

classes.name: CreateSnapshotActionOpts
classes.description: Configuration options for creating a snapshot, including selector, paths, operation manager, execution context, and user.

classes.name: CreateSnapshotAction
classes.description: Encapsulates actions to create a snapshot, holding necessary context and methods to run the operation.

methods.name: NewCreateSnapshotAction
methods.description: Constructor function for CreateSnapshotAction, initializing it with provided options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the snapshot creation process asynchronously, returning an operation object.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Performs the actual snapshot creation steps: suspend, take snapshot, and resume.
